spans.s:
ind.
Where, in what place or degree.

m. (-ङ्गुः)
A sort of Panick: see कङ्गु.

m. (-णः)
1 The sound or tone of any musical instrument.
2 Sound in general.
E.
क्वण to sound, अप् affix; also क्वाण.

m. (-णः)
The sound of musical instruments.
E.
क्वण to sound, affix घञ्: see क्वण.

mfn. (-णन्-णन्ती-णत्^1)
Sounding.
E.
क्वण, and शतृ aff.
[1] Correction submitted by SergeA on 20161216. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/323, batche 313.

n. (-नं)
The sound of any musical instrument.
m. (-नः)
A small earthen pot or boiler.
E.
क्वण to sound, affix ल्युट्.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Sounded, twanged.
E.
क्वण to sound, क्त aff.

mfn. (-त्यः-त्या-त्यं)
Of or belonging to where or what place.
E.
त्यप् added to क्व.

r. 1st cl. (ए,) क्वथे (क्वथति)
To decoct, to boil, to prepare by heat, to digest.

m. (-थः)
1 A decoction, any solution or infusion prepared with a continued and gentle heat.
2 Pain, sorrow.
3 Calamity, distress.
4 The mixture of the materials for a decoction.
E.
क्वथ to decoct, घञ् aff.

n. (-नं)
Boiling, decocting.
E.
क्वथ to boil, ल्युट् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Boiled, decocted, stewed, digested.
E.
क्वथ to decoct, &c. affix क्त.

n. (-वं)
Blue vitriol used as a collyrium.
E.
क्वाथ, and उद्भव produced.
